scope: Inactive held canonical metadata evaluation and forward scope/lifetime alignment on a populated PostgreSQL predecessor
source_manifest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys, compact separators, no trailing newline; source-array order retained
image_scope: Cached dependency images with exact current read-only source mounts; no rebuilt application-image or deployed-runtime qualification.

preservation.change_limit: Exactly three function bodies change; all canonical rows, existing ledger entries, table inventory, function identities/metadata, table ACLs/RLS/owners, role flags/memberships and triggers are preserved.

source_proof_bytes.case: native held evaluation enforces the real reviewed source-proof byte cap before body retrieval and evaluation

whole_aggregate_bytes_and_nodes.limitation: Aggregate byte and node overflow use synthetic-query unit controls and are not claimed as native database coverage.

qualification_boundaries.held_snapshot: Concurrent ACL changes, reviewed withdrawal, producer revocation and taxonomy publication retain the prior held snapshot; fresh readers observe the new state.
qualification_boundaries.final_session_check: Real wall-clock expiry refuses the final envelope; later committed revocation is not claimed visible inside the held repeatable-read snapshot.

pipeline.publication: STEP_OUTCOME_ONLY; raw private database and authentication evidence is not exported.

limitations: This local synthetic qualification does not establish hosted CI, API/browser integration, a clean image build, vendor-live integration, deployment or release readiness.
The held evaluator returns an inactive diagnostic envelope with contentAuthority:false; no effect capability, live content route, ingress cutover or activation is qualified.
The 98 predecessor cases execute before SQL036. Historical SQL031 qualification scopes and outcomes are not relabelled.

The source-bound harness enforced canonical row equality and exact catalog changes. Offline review checked retained hashes, inventories, ledger and replay assertions; it did not perform a second database read.
The 2MiB source-proof boundary has native coverage. Whole 8MiB/node aggregate overflow remains unit-only.
Read-only repeatable-read provides a coherent held snapshot, not visibility of a later committed revocation or a reusable post-commit authorization token.
